CaCO3 + CO2 + H2O → Ca(HCO3)2

This reaction is important in the erosion of carbonate rocks, forming caverns, and leads to hard water in many regions.

Fa-hien or Fa Xian, a Chinese pilgrim, visited India during the reign of Chandra Gupta II. His primary aim was to visit the Buddhist religious places and to take with him the copies of the Buddhist religious texts. Fa-hien started his voyage to India in 399 A.D. He reached India about 400 A.D. and remained here up to 411 A.D.

He visited Peshawar, Taxila, Mathura, Kannauj. Sravasti, Kapilavastu, Sarnath and many other places. He embarked for Ceylon at the sea-port of Tamralipti (West Bengal). He remained in Ceylon (Sri Lanka) for two years and then reached China via Jawa in 414 A.D.

Gross Primary Deficit is Gross Fiscal Deficit less interest payments. Net Primary Deficit is Net Fiscal Deficit minus net interest payments. Net interest payment is interest paid minus interest receipt. A shrinking primary deficit indicates progress towards fiscal health.

Newsprint Control Order, 2004 governs the news print sector in India.

Newsprint was under the ambit of Essential Commodities Act 1955. Its manufacture and trade was governed by the Newsprint Control Order 1962. In 2004, newsprint was taken out of the essential commodities act and the Newsprint Control Order was rescinded. In its place the Newsprint Control Order 2004 was promulgated.

Generally, igneous rocks are formed by the cooling and crystallization of magma.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of

the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of

the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Subject (Objective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

For example:

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c): Our country witnessed a terrible disaster.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. She frankly confessed that she couldn't _________ to purchase a car then.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She frankly confessed that she couldn't _________ to purchase a car then.
questions.solution:
The blank requires a verb that denotes the inability of the person to buy a car. Among the given options, 'spend' (give (money) to pay for goods, services, or so as to benefit someone or something), 'stand' (rise to one's feet) and 'tolerate' (accept or endure (someone or something unpleasant or disliked) with forbearance) are contextually irrelevant and do not give the meaning that is required by the sentence and so they are negated. Option (b) 'afford' (have enough money to pay for) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and gives the meaning that is required by it.

The complete sentence is: She frankly confessed that she couldn't afford to purchase a car then.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence. The blind man said to me, "Can you help me cross the road?"
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The blind man said to me, "Can you help me cross the road?"

options.text: The blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road.
options.html: The blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road.

options.text: The blind man asked me if I will help him cross the road.
options.html: The blind man asked me if I will help him cross the road.

options.text: The blind man asked me if I could help him crossed the road.
options.html: The blind man asked me if I could help him crossed the road.

options.text: The blind man asked me if I can help him cross the road.
options.html: The blind man asked me if I can help him cross the road.

questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

If there is a question in the Direct Speech whose answer can come as "Yes" or "No" in the Indirect Speech, we should use the conjunctions "if" or "whether".

For example:

Ravi said to me, "Is she studying?" (Direct Speech)

Ravi asked me if she was studying. (Indirect Speech)

Also, when converting direct speech into indirect speech, the present modal verbs (can/may/must/will/shall) should be changed into past modal verbs (could/might/had to/would/should).

Example: She said, "I can speak ten languages." (Direct Speech)

She said that she could speak ten languages. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

'Said to me' is changed to 'asked me'.

'If' is introduced in the sentence.

'Can you' will be changed to 'I could'

'Help me' will be changed to 'Help him'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (a): The blind man asked me if I could help him cross the road.

The complete sentence is: One has to be persistent in studies if he/she wants to get his/her dream job. Success will remain unattainable if one studies by fits and starts.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentences in active voice. The important points were narrated in the class by the teacher.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentences in active voice.

The important points were narrated in the class by the teacher.

options.text: In the class, the important points were narrated.
options.html: In the class, the important points were narrated.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Subject (Objective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

For example:

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c): The teacher narrated the important points in the class.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. She becomes frustrated with her poor health and began to lose _______ of her recovery.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She becomes frustrated with her poor health and began to lose _______ of her recovery.
questions.solution:
The blank requires a noun that denotes the thing that the subject begins to lose as a result of frustration of her health's condition. Among the given options, 'weight' (a body's relative mass or the quantity of matter contained by it, giving rise to a downward force; the heaviness of a person or thing), 'idea' (a thought or suggestion as to a possible course of action) and 'money' are contextually irrelevant options and so they are negated. Option (d) 'hope' (a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular thing to happen) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can fill the given blank.

The complete sentence is: She becomes frustrated with her poor health and began to lose hope of her recovery.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. She has / a habit of / spending against / her means.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

She has / a habit of / spending against / her means.
questions.solution:
The part mentioned in option (c) has an error. In the afore-mentioned part, the preposition 'against' (in opposition to) is an incorrect word, which needs to be replaced by the preposition 'beyond' ('to be more than or not limited to something') and it indicates that the subject spends way more than her means ('i.e., resources') allow her.

The correct sentence is: She has a habit of spending beyond her means.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

questions.question: Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order. In December 2018 P. caused a landslide that Q. an eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatau R. triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait (Indonesia) S. and killed more than 400 people
questions.questionHtml:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

In December 2018

P. caused a landslide that

Q. an eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatau

R. triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait (Indonesia)

S. and killed more than 400 people
questions.solution:
The given parts of a sentence talk about an incident in which a volcano eruption leads to various consequences. Part Q has to be the first part as it talks about the primary cause of the incident and it is followed by the effect of the incident which is mentioned in the pair PR. So, the pair follows part Q and part S comes as the last part which indicates the other destruction that is caused by the volcanic eruption and the tsunami. So, the correct order of the parts of the sentence is QPRS.

The correct sentence is: In December 2018, an eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatau caused a landslide that triggered a tsunami in the Sunda Strait (Indonesia) and killed more than 400 people.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank A.

questions.solution:
The blank requires a noun to denote the thing in which work went on, during the pandemic. Accordingly, 'fields' (an area of open land, especially one planted with crops or pasture, typically bounded by hedges or fences), 'sections' (any of the more or less distinct parts into which something is or may be divided or from which it is made up) and 'areas' (a subject or range of activity or interest) are contextually irrelevant words that do not give the meaning that is required by the sentence and so they are negated. Option (a) 'sectors' (a distinct part or branch of a nation's economy or society or of a sphere of activity such as education) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can fill the given blank as required.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank B.

questions.solution:
The blank requires a verb that denotes the action that is done to do deal with the effect of the lockdown. Accordingly, 'substitute' (use or add in place of), 'replenish' (restore (a stock or supply) to a former level or condition) and 'substantiate' (provide evidence to support or prove the truth of) are contextually irrelevant words that do not give the meaning that is required by the sentence and so they are negated. Option (b) 'reduce' (make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can fill the given blank as required.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank C.

The blank requires a verb that denotes the action that is about to be done with respect to hybrid model of working. Accordingly, 'analysing' (examine (something) methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it), 'examining' (inspect (someone or something) thoroughly in order to determine their nature or condition) and 'observing' (watch (someone or something) carefully and attentively) are contextually irrelevant words that do not give the meaning that is required by the sentence and so they are negated. Option (c) 'considering' (think carefully about (something), typically before making a decision) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and can fill the given blank as required.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank D.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank D.
questions.solution:
The blank requires a noun to denote the thing or condition by which the act of hiring is anticipated to happen. Accordingly, 'formula' (a method or procedure for achieving something), and 'standard' (a required or agreed level of quality or attainment) are contextually irrelevant words that do not give the meaning that is required by the sentence and so they are negated. Option (d) 'criterion' (a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided) is the most appropriate word that matches the context of the sentence and is also grammatically correct because it is preceded by the singular determiner 'a' and which is why option (c) cannot fill the blank. 'Criteria' is the plural form of 'criterion'.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

Note:

Determiner: A modifying word that determines the kind of reference a noun or noun group has, for example, 'a', 'the', 'every', 'much', 'many', etc.
